items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: I guess Eddie Dawson drills one of them. That was, I think Eddie Dawson still has, he's a lieutenant or something now. He's a big man up in there.

ctx.x: I was just wondering what a drilling group did. I haven't heard about them.

The drilling groups? Well they have little things they do on the street, you know. Quite a while ago they used to have the Tentamere parades around here. And they used to have quite a few drilling groups in there, Odd Fellows and different things. You've never seen the Fancy drill, huh? And they had different things at different marches and different things they do and everything was in march time, you know, for that 6-8 temple that they mostly used to drill on. Well that would be for parades. Yeah, it's sort of…

You see, you didn't make the DC. You arrested, that's what happened. Oh, Lee, that's what messed it up. You thought it was happening. Oh, you just got to lay out the first time. Huh? Why are you stopping it? Well, I didn't, I thought, I thought you knew where you were. If you'd have just stayed in here the second time, everything had been all right. I didn't know what, see, I didn't know what rest you would count. You're right, you're right. I see what you mean. Well, he was supposed to be out. No, I was supposed…
